survivorAssessments.assessment: Equivalent equal-extent reuse: same file/version/actual column and equal end identify identical immutable text/flags, so reusing the old row changes no rendered bytes.

Equivalent defensive missing-row guard at fragment entry: interactive fragment controls are rendered only for rows present in sourceRows, and replacing rows removes those controls synchronously. Detached programmatic clicks are outside the supported UI.

resourcePolicy: Stock Stryker command runner, one worker, nice -n 10. No parallel mutation cohorts. Browser scripts explicitly forward the active mutant into each page.
limits: Full affected accept/fragment functions and inspector public methods, not the entire renderer. Initial tests grew during survivor investigation; cohorts overlap. A failing-test catch on identical production source remains detected when a later longer suite times out; every raw cohort outcome is retained. Timeouts are never counted as catches. Equivalent survivors remain raw survivors.
